calendar1_name.description: Name of the first calendar instance section.

calendar1_type.description: Type of the first calendar (ical, caldav, exchange, or ews).

calendar1_url.description: URL to the first shared calendar.

calendar1_user.description: Web username for the first calendar.

calendar1_secret.description: Web password for the first calendar.

calendar1_refresh.description: Refresh interval in minutes for the first calendar.

calendar1_timeframe.description: Timeframe in minutes of calendar data to pull for each refresh period for the first calendar.

calendar1_fetch_again_at_reload.description: Reload calendar content when the module is reloaded for the first calendar.

calendar1_autoreminder.description: Override event-defined reminder before each busy status (in mins) for the first calendar.

calendar1_channel.description: Channel to dial for the first calendar.

calendar1_context.description: Context to connect to on answer for the first calendar.

calendar1_extension.description: Extension to connect to on answer for the first calendar.

calendar1_app.description: Application to execute on answer (instead of context/extension) for the first calendar.

calendar1_appdata.description: Data part of application to execute on answer for the first calendar.

calendar1_waittime.description: How long to wait for an answer, defaults to 30 seconds for the first calendar.

calendar1_setvar.description: Channel variable name to set on the notification channel for the first calendar.
